public.note: Brokerage + Roth IRA. base = ACH deposits + journals in − disbursements/journals out + Public IRA match, from statements Oct 2025–Aug 2026. Later deposits come from Plaid.

fidelity.note: 401(k). base = every 'Contributions' row in NetBenefits history.csv (Jul 2025–Sep 2026, employee + match). Later ones come from Plaid.

merrill.note: ESPP + Visa equity plan. Uses the holdings' cost basis (ESPP purchase price, RSU value at vest), so no base is needed.
